moments.what: a chocolate bar on the counter sags and drips as the camera pushes in
the camera pushes close on the bar, its wrapper label lit
a small Raytheon badge glows on the microwave's door
the camera pulls back: the microwave beside it hums, its window glowing, plate turning

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: How did melted chocolate give Raytheon the microwave?

params.place: a wartime radar lab, a test bench under a lamp

moments.what: the year flips onto the wall calendar
the radar dish swings round and the calendar year pulses
the scope's blips flare green
a radar dish on the bench turns, a sweep glowing on its round screen
a lab coat hangs on a stand by the bench, a name tag writes on
the camera pushes toward the coat's pocket, a candy bar peeking out
the pocket glows warm from inside
the bar droops over the pocket's edge and drips

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: In 1945, radar engineer Percy Spencer felt the chocolate in his pocket go soft.

params.place: the test bench, the magnetron on its stand

moments.what: the bench's lamp, wires and dials sit cold and blue
a thermometer on the bench stays low, its bulb blue
the thermometer flashes blue again and a cold spotlight lands on the empty middle of the bench
the copper magnetron rises on its stand and glows, a label writes on
the camera circles the finned copper tube
its antenna tip flares bright
rings of waves pulse out of its antenna toward the coat

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Nothing near him was hot, so what melted it? A magnetron: the tube that makes microwaves.

moments.what: the tube slices open: a copper ring of holes around a thin wire
two magnets slide on above and below, glowing field lines between them
the field lines between the magnets brighten
a cloud of blue electrons leaves the centre wire
the electrons curl into a spinning wheel with spokes
the wheel of spokes speeds up
the copper ring catches a warm light
the spokes sweep past the ring's little cavities, each lighting as they pass

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Inside, a magnet bends electrons into a spinning wheel past little copper cavities.

params.place: one cavity, close up inside the ring

moments.what: the camera holds on one keyhole cavity as a spoke sweeps past
the cavity pulses amber in rhythm
glowing ripples shiver out of its mouth
the camera pulls back: every cavity sends ripples into the antenna
a stream of waves pours out of the tube's antenna

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Each cavity rings like a whistle, and invisible waves pour out.

params.place: inside a popcorn kernel, among water molecules

moments.what: waves sweep through; water molecules flip back and forth with them
a label names one molecule: water
the molecules flip faster, a wave crest passing through them
the molecules glow from blue to orange as they shake faster
the molecules start shrinking away as the camera pulls back
the camera pulls back: they sit inside a kernel on the bench by the tube
the kernel bursts into white popcorn and others pop around it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: They shake the water in food, and that shaking is heat. He tried popcorn: it popped.

params.place: a Raytheon workshop, the oven built part by part

moments.what: the magnetron sits alone on a workbench, waves leaking off in every direction
a dinner plate slides onto the bench beside the tube
the leaking rings flare brighter for a moment
the leaking waves start to shrink back
the last leaking waves fade into the dark
a sign reading Raytheon lights over the workbench
the back wall of a box slams down behind the tube
the magnetron's copper glows hot
the other steel walls fly in one by one around the tube
the box closes; waves bounce inside it, seen through the walls
a nameplate lands on the door: Radarange

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But to cook dinner, the waves had to stay inside. So Raytheon shut the tube in a metal box: the Radarange.

params.place: an old showroom floor under spotlights

moments.what: the tall Radarange cabinet rolls into the spotlight
the cabinet stops in the light, its window glowing on
the cabinet's top edge lights up cyan
a person's outline rises beside it, the cabinet almost as tall
a height bracket draws between the floor and the cabinet's top
a freight scale under it swings, its weight counting up on the dial
the scale's platform sinks with a bounce under the weight
a price tag swings down from the cabinet's handle
the price counts up on the tag
the tag swings once more on its string as the price climbs
the price flashes bigger as it lands and the spotlights brighten

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The first one stood almost as tall as a man, weighed 750 pounds and cost about $5,000.

params.place: back in the dark kitchen at night

moments.what: the tall Radarange shrinks into today's microwave on the counter
the microwave turns see-through: the small magnetron glows inside
the little magnetron pulses with rings of waves
the kitchen lights up around it, the plate turning
the oven's window glows brighter
a candy bar slides onto the counter beside it and starts to sag
the bar's red wrapper catches the light
the camera pushes toward the bar as it drips, as in the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Today that same tube hums in your kitchen, all thanks to one melted candy bar.
